action_class.PERFORM: 主体执行可见表演动作
action_class.TRANSITION: 主体或画面进入过渡状态

camera_direction.RIGHT: 相机向右运动；不是主体向右移动

camera_movement.PAN: 相机水平摇摄；不是主体水平移动

primary_purpose.EMPHASIZE_EMOTION: 强调主体的情绪或表情

background_visibility.BACKGROUND_SOFTLY_BLURRED: 主体后方背景柔化可见
background_visibility.ENVIRONMENT_VISIBLE_BEHIND_SUBJECT: 主体后方环境保持可见
background_visibility.RAIN_SOFTLY_BLURRED: 主体后方雨景柔化可见
background_visibility.STREET_VISIBLE_AROUND_SUBJECT: 主体周围街道环境保持可见

focus_target.EYES_AND_TEARS: 焦点落在眼睛与可见泪水
focus_target.SUBJECT: 焦点落在主体整体
focus_target.SUBJECT_ACTION: 焦点落在主体的可见动作

subject_placement.LEFT_THIRD: 主体位于画面左侧三分线
subject_placement.RIGHT_THIRD: 主体位于画面右侧三分线

subject_scale.FACE_DOMINANT: 主体面部占据画面大部分区域
subject_scale.FULL_SUBJECT_VISIBLE: 主体整体保持完整可见
subject_scale.SUBJECT_SMALL_IN_ENVIRONMENT: 主体在环境中保持较小画面占比
subject_scale.UPPER_BODY_VISIBLE: 主体上半身保持完整可见

entry_environment_state.CONTINUOUS_RAIN: 进入镜头时背景保持持续降雨
entry_environment_state.SAME_INDOOR_ENVIRONMENT: 进入镜头时室内环境保持连续
entry_environment_state.SAME_NIGHT_STREET: 进入镜头时夜间街道环境保持连续

entry_subject_state.SUBJECT_ALREADY_CRYING: 主体进入镜头时已经哭泣
entry_subject_state.SUBJECT_ALREADY_SMILING: 主体进入镜头时已经微笑

exit_environment_state.CONTINUOUS_RAIN: 离开镜头时背景仍保持持续降雨
exit_environment_state.SAME_INDOOR_ENVIRONMENT: 离开镜头时室内环境继续保持连续
exit_environment_state.SAME_NIGHT_STREET: 离开镜头时夜间街道环境继续保持连续

exit_subject_state.CRYING_CONTINUES: 主体离开镜头时继续哭泣
exit_subject_state.SMILE_CONTINUES: 主体离开镜头时继续微笑

highlight_state.NATURAL_FACE_HIGHLIGHT: 面部自然高光保持可见
highlight_state.NO_SPECIAL_HIGHLIGHT: 主体不依赖特殊高光辨识
highlight_state.SUBJECT_EDGE_HIGHLIGHT: 主体边缘高光保持可见

light_quality.DIRECTIONAL_LOW_KEY: 定向低调光保持环境层次

subject_readability.FACE_FULLY_READABLE: 主体面部细节清晰可读
subject_readability.MOTION_FULLY_READABLE: 主体运动轮廓清晰可读
subject_readability.SUBJECT_FULLY_READABLE: 主体整体细节清晰可读

detail_state.RELAXED_FACE_VISIBLE: 放松的面部细节清楚可见

orientation_state.MOVING_LEFT_TO_RIGHT: 主体从画面左侧向右侧移动

performance_intensity.GENTLE: 可见动作强度保持轻柔
performance_intensity.MODERATE: 可见动作强度保持适中
performance_intensity.RESTRAINED: 可见动作强度保持克制

visible_action_state.FORWARD_MOTION: 向前运动状态清楚可见

continuity_anchor.SAME_SUBJECT_AND_ENVIRONMENT: 同一主体与同一环境状态
